description: Change columns on an existing row of a table; only the columns given are touched. It runs as the configured credential, under the same row-level security and column rules as the app.

project.description: The project to act on: a registered project's name (rebase_project_list), or a Rebase Cloud project's slug or id. Optional when the session's directory is linked to the intended project. Refused when it names a different project than the directory's link.

table.description: The table's slug, as served at /api/data/<table> (e.g. "orders")

name: update_row
